learning_outcomes.text: Plan a multi-file feature with Claude Code before changing any code
Break a feature into ordered, verifiable steps Claude Code can execute
Keep changes coherent across many files and avoid partial, broken states
Review a multi-file change for correctness and scope creep
Decide when to pause planning and start implementing
